supersession_reason: Pre-activation audit found two economic-accounting defects: ladder status was being scored as action, and known first transitions were incorrectly cost-free. No governed DEL run existed, so v1.2 fixes the preregistration before activation without rewriting evidence.
question: Do explicitly published Compass actions create economically useful decisions per asset segment after costs when compared point-in-time with simple frozen alternatives?

action_source.rule: Only the explicit frozen action field is economically scored. capitalization_ladder[].status is descriptive state and must never be substituted for action. Historical freezes without action remain COMPASS_ACTION_UNSCORABLE.

unit_of_evidence: First official Compass freeze with data_status OK per ISO week is the primary inference unit. Other freezes are descriptive.

interpretations.INCUMBENT_HOLDER: Starts invested. HOLD, PREPARE, WAIT and HARD_WAIT are no-trade actions. Exposure changes only on an explicit DEPLOY/BUY or EXIT/SELL action.
interpretations.FRESH_CAPITAL: Starts in cash. HOLD, PREPARE, WAIT and HARD_WAIT are no-trade actions. Enters only on explicit DEPLOY/BUY and exits only on explicit EXIT/SELL.

challengers.CORE_STATE_BTC100_5PCT: BTC cumulative index versus 100-day simple moving average. Enter above MA*1.05 and exit below MA*0.95. Uses returns dated strictly before the decision day. Shadow challenger only.

cost_semantics: Charge cost only on absolute exposure change. Each interpretation has an explicit starting exposure, so a first BUY/DEPLOY from FRESH_CAPITAL or a first SELL/EXIT from INCUMBENT_HOLDER is a real chargeable transition. A first no-trade observation has zero turnover. Challenger transitions are charged from the same interpretation-specific starting exposure.

segment_return_owner.rule: DEL must fail closed rather than use the Cowork proxy segment series as canonical evidence.

primary_metrics: weekly-block mean paired_delta by segment at 7d
share of weekly blocks where Compass is economically better than each challenger

decision_rules.ACTION_VALUE_REVIEW: After at least 12 independent weekly blocks with adequate regime coverage, route an owner review for any segment whose Compass decision path is not economically distinguishable from simpler alternatives or whose opportunity/protection trade-off is persistently dominated. Review only, never automatic.
decision_rules.CORE_STATE_REVIEW: No promotion claim is allowed from DEL row means alone. A later preregistered path-metrics extension must first implement max drawdown, matched-exposure comparison and upside capture, then require at least 26 weekly blocks and at least one prospective BTC drawdown of 20% or more.
decision_rules.KILL_CORE_STATE: If a later prospective path-metrics extension shows the challenger does not improve drawdown versus buy-and-hold or does not beat static matched exposure on risk-adjusted terms, kill it as a challenger candidate.

multiple_testing: All segment, interpretation, challenger and non-primary-horizon combinations are descriptive. No new challenger may be added to this frozen experiment. New challengers require a new preregistration.
leakage_controls: challenger state uses returns dated strictly before decision day
missing returns are DATA_MISSING and never zero
prose is not converted into action semantics
status is not converted into action semantics
historical replay may falsify but never authorize promotion
historical_evidence_status: Nightshift Omega 2026-09-25 is prior research context, not promotion evidence. DEL v1.1 produced no governed evidence before being superseded.
activation_gate: Do not schedule DEL until a governed segment-return owner exists, Compass prospectively freezes explicit per-segment action fields, and the focused DEL v1.2 tests are green.
